champions.recap: Kashif went 9-5 while ranking only 6th in scoring, then got hot after trade-deadline deals (Mahomes and Evans for Josh Allen and Amari Cooper). He beat Rohan 177-110, top seed Ayaz 176-124, and reigning champ Daniyal 196-140 in the final, with seven players scoring 19 or more.
champions.quote: When people told me I wasn't going to win, I listened to the one person who told me I was: me.

champions.recap: A first-round bye, then a 159-111 win over Saaf behind 43 points from Breece Hall. Daniyal edged Rohan 153-151 in the final on a 38-point Davante Adams game and became the first GM with two rings.
champions.quote: Amidst a league of boys copping wedding rings, stands a man copping championship rings 💍💍 #EarnednotGiven

champions.recap: A late Christian McCaffrey surge got the 5th seed into the playoffs. Saaf beat Kashif, then Zohabe 163-145 on a 36-point Josh Allen game, and won the final 143-127 over first-time finalist Dheeraj behind 31 from DeVonta Smith.
champions.quote: When you win, you attract nazr, when you lose, you learn sabr.

champions.recap: The second-best record in league history, plus a 5-game win streak, earned the 1 seed. Umaize beat Daniyal 105-54 in the semifinal, then defending champ Humza 163-125 in the final, led by Joe Mixon and Davante Adams.
champions.quote: You know, I'm something of a sports analyst myself.

champions.recap: A 4th seed with no steady QB (Minshew, Tua, then Taysom Hill) rode Dalvin Cook and DeAndre Hopkins. It beat Zohabe by 31, Dheeraj by nearly 60, and Saaf 183-135 in the final behind 38 from Jalen Hurts in his only fantasy start.
champions.quote: I may be down bad, but at least I'm not dog-water at fantasy like the rest of the league.

champions.recap: Ezekiel Elliott and Aaron Jones carried the 2 seed. It edged the 6th-seeded Shlump Boyz 125.68-120.66 in the semifinal, then beat Humza's Swim with Charks 152.96-106.44 in the final.
champions.quote: Virginity is not dignity, it is just lack of opportunity.

champions.recap: The league's first champion. Mahomes and Ezekiel Elliott got the 5th seed in at 6-6. Baby Johnny beat Team Khanzada 172.3-111.6, the 1 seed Team Malik 175.1-150.6, and Team Bakali 147.8-74.1 in the final.
champions.quote: Don't cry because it's over, smile because it happened.
